body:
## Pull request overview

Adds missing documentation pages and site integration for six existing ObjectUI plugins (timeline, chatbot, calendar, calendar-view, gantt, map) so they appear in the docs navigation and can be demonstrated on the site.

**Changes:**
- Added new MDX documentation pages for 6 plugins and included them in the plugins sidebar/navigation.
- Updated the plugins index page (categories + bundle impact table) to include the new plugins.
- Updated the docs site to depend on and lazily load the new plugin packages for demos.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 10 out of 11 changed files in this pull request and generated 13 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| pnpm-lock.yaml | Adds workspace links for the newly referenced plugins in the site app. |
| apps/site/package.json | Adds workspace deps for the 6 plugin packages so the site can import them. |
| apps/site/app/components/InteractiveDemo.tsx | Extends client-side lazy imports to include the 6 new plugins. |
| content/docs/plugins/index.md | Reorganizes plugin listing + adds new plugins + updates bundle impact table. |
| content/docs/plugins/meta.json | Adds the 6 new plugin docs pages to the sidebar navigation. |
| content/docs/plugins/plugin-timeline.mdx | New Timeline plugin docs with interactive examples and API sections. |
| content/docs/plugins/plugin-chatbot.mdx | New Chatbot plugin docs with interactive examples and API sections. |
| content/docs/plugins/plugin-calendar-view.mdx | New Calendar View plugin docs with interactive examples and API sections. |
| content/docs/plugins/plugin-calendar.mdx | New ObjectQL Calendar plugin docs. |
| content/docs/plugins/plugin-gantt.mdx | New ObjectQL Gantt plugin docs. |
| content/docs/plugins/plugin-map.mdx | New ObjectQL Map plugin docs. |
</details>

The "TypeScript Support" snippet won’t type-check: `ObjectGridSchema` is defined with `type: 'object-grid'`, but this example uses `type: 'object-calendar'`. Consider typing this example as `SchemaNode`/`any`, or exporting a dedicated schema type for `object-calendar`.

The schema API here advertises `onTaskClick`, but the registered renderer (`packages/plugin-gantt/src/index.tsx`) only passes `schema` into `ObjectGantt` and does not forward callbacks, so this schema field won’t be invoked. Either document the supported callback mechanism or update the plugin renderer to forward handlers.

This "TypeScript Support" snippet won’t type-check against `@object-ui/types`: `CalendarViewSchema` requires an `events` array, but the example builds `data: events` and omits `events`. Either change the example to match the exported type shape or type the schema as `SchemaNode`/`any`.
```suggestion

```

The schema API here advertises `onEventClick`/`onDateClick`, but the registered renderer (`packages/plugin-calendar/src/index.tsx`) only passes `schema` into `ObjectCalendar` and does not wire callbacks, so these schema fields won’t be invoked. Either document the supported callback mechanism or update the plugin renderer to forward handlers.

JSX prop is written as `description: "..."` which is invalid syntax in MDX/JSX and will break the docs build. Use `description="..."` (or `{...}`) like the other examples.
```suggestion

```
